content:
maria: heads up — saw a handful of users become org-admins after today's SCIM run, but they shouldn't have the admin role. :eyes:
kevin: can you share repro or logs? which attribute changed?
maria: looks like a new 'role_tag' attribute is being picked up from our IdP after group rename. sync-bot shows a `2xx PATCH` on group membership and our provisioner merged tags. short thread: group 'eng-platform-admins' renamed -> idp sent `roleTag=platform-admin` on users -> our merging logic set admin=true.
dylan: ugh. that sounds like the "role tag propagation" flow we added last quarter. possible we didn't gate it behind the explicit mapping flag.
maria: repro steps i ran (small set):
```
# 1) create group rename in IdP (old: eng-platform-admins -> new: platform-admins)
# 2) IdP SCIM patch for user: { "schemas": [...], "Operations": [{"op":"replace","path":"roles/0","value":"platform-admin"}]}
# 3) our sync job logs: merged role_tag -> assigned RBAC role id 42 (org_admin)
```
kevin: can you paste the exact log lines from provisioner?
maria: sure:
```
2026-03-15T10:02:11Z provisioner.INFO scim: patch user uid=U123 role_tag=platform-admin src=okta
2026-03-15T10:02:11Z provisioner.INFO rbac: ensure_role_assignment user=U123 role_id=42 reason=auto_role_tag_propagation
```
dylan: i think two issues: (1) mapping table between role_tag -> role_id has a fallback to "most permissive" when ambiguous, and (2) group-rename delta treated as additive instead of replace, so tags stick.
irini: mitigation ideas: 1) disable auto_role_tag_propagation feature-flag for now; 2) block mapping fallback to permissive (fail instead); 3) run a reconcile to revoke org_admin from anyone without explicit admin group membership.
kevin: agree. infra-bot, can you pause today's scheduled SCIM sync? we should stop additional contamination.
infra-bot: scheduled job scim-sync-00 paused by @kevin at 2026-03-15T10:20:02Z
maria: also proposing an audit query to find affected accounts quickly:
```sql
SELECT u.id, u.email, r.name, a.created_at
FROM role_assignments a
JOIN users u ON a.user_id = u.id
JOIN roles r ON a.role_id = r.id
WHERE a.grant_reason = 'auto_role_tag_propagation' AND a.created_at >= '2026-03-15';
```
kevin: perfect. run it and share list privately. will start a rollback script to revoke role_id=42 for those without explicit admin group mapping.
dylan: i'll draft a fix: (A) change mapping fallback to explicit fail, (B) treat SCIM group replace as replace not additive, (C) add a one-time safety check in provisioner to prefer explicit group membership over inferred tags. i'll open PR and assign to @maria for review.
maria: adding to incident timeline: detect (10:02), pause sync (10:20), revoke script started (10:35), PR opened (10:48). please add any audit logs you pull.
irini: could be worth checking KMS audit for any admin-key actions during window just in case — i'll ping security-ops.
kevin: thanks. action owners: dylan (fix + PR), maria (revoke + audit), irini (kms audit), me (pause + coord).
maria: noted. :white_check_mark:
sync-bot: SCIM sync completed in 00:03:12, 1 warn(s) — refer to provisioner logs.
kevin: keep thread updated when revoke finished.
